book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Soo Te Pabe'e ka Jericho mee naneadu-too meana.
Sumu'yoo nana besa manepunnedu Zacchaeus mee naneadu ka tumasumudoope nemadunagadu oonow.
Ka Te Pabe'e soopoonne pana gi oo poonne. Nagutza ewatseoo mu numu ka meetze'e oo wunu.
Ka sunngabe-ma tuboyahoo ka Te Pabe'e tu kumi meakwuse.
Soo Te Pabe'e ka sunngabe-toohakwi meana anguse ka Zacchaeus poonnese mee oo netamma, “Yabeupu wueke nu u-baa'yookwu yaa tabeno.”
Zacchaeus besa soonammese wuekese ka Te Pabe'e tu nobe-kwitoo bika.
Mu numu ka Te Pabe'e nesootzemakooha mee oo netamma, “Soo Jesus ka tuma'emukwadu-baa'yookwu.”
Soo Zacchaeus ka Te Pabe'e mee netamma, “Nu naamookwitu ka e hee-ga-matu mu tutuha manedu numu namadeakwu. Nu ka mu numu e tutuhana watsu oo-koobakwi nu oo makodyukudooa.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo, “Yaa tabeno-manakwana u ka u dooamu-no namagwetzoikwu. Yaa tabeno u Te Naa tooa manekwu.
Nu yaa teepu-koobatoo nataya tuma'emukwadu magwetzoikwuse.”

Mu numu ka Te Pabe'e nakapunnena, “Soo Te Pabe'e mooasoo ka Jerusalem tzage'e oosoo ka o petugase soo Te Naa mu numu-kooba katuna mu moohekwudu ka Te Pabe'e mayugwekwu,” mee mu numu sokwamapunne. Soo Te Pabe'e mu sokwamana sopedakwadoo yise mee mu netamma, “O'no umu oo nakasopedakwadookwu gi meno'osoo namanikwudu nu saa'a numu moohekwudu.”

Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo mu natugwe'nga, “Soo sumu'yoo nana ka numu-kooba katudu nanumu ka mu numu-kooba pumme tu neyugwese oosoo ka umu sumumano (10) pumme tummatzidu mee netamma, ‘Nu nanasusu'muhoo oa tupe mu hemegakwu. Mu saa'a mu ma'ewadooa. Nu kwinga'a meakwu ka no'oko tamme-kooba katudu-matoo oosoo mu-kooba katudu e nemayugwekwu. Nu yise nanemamakwutooase yise saa'a yowsoo kodyu petukwu, mu ka oa tupe ma'ewase saa'a nu-matoosoo oo makodyukudooa.’

Soo numu-kooba katudu yise mea susumudu mu numu otuoo ka nana gi petzabena sumuoo numu taya ka no'oko numu-kooba katudu-matoo mee oo tunetammakute, ‘Gi ookow nana ka numme-kooba katukwudu nemayugwepana, numme gi oo petzape.’
Pana oosoo numu-kooba katudu naneyugwese yise punowsoo kodyukakwu. Ka petugase, ka umu pumme tummatzidu nabatoo bi. ‘Howgena umu e tuma'ewaku?’ mee soonammena.
Soo mooe'ugasoo oa tupe nageadu oo-baa petuse

mee oo netamma, ‘U sumuoo oa tupe e gea nu oo ma'ewase meno'o yise nu sumumano (10) u makodyukukwu.’ Soo numu-kooba katudu yise mee oo netamma, ‘U tubetse besa manepu-ga'yoo. U besa e tumatugukupu ka sumuoosoo ume e gease. Meno'o yise nu besa u sootunagakwu, nu sumumano (10) nanakumma'akoosoo numu-kooba u nemadabuekwu.’
Soo penakwatu oo-baa petuse, punno'o meeoo, ‘U sumuoosoo oa tupe e gease, nu yise punno'o oo ma'ewase meno'o mangeoo oa tupe nu u makodyukudooa.’
Soo numu-kooba katudu meeoo oo netamma, ‘U punno'o besa manepu-ga'yoo u manegeoo nanakumma'akoosoo numu-kooba nemadabuekwu.’
Kumma'yoosoo yise oo-baa petuhoose, mee oo netamma, ‘Yaa soo oa tupe nuka u geapu nu a makodyukukwusoo. Nu wanapu-naga a watzetugu.
Nu oo watzetugu ka u-ma suina, u nenadu'ya. U ooosapa numu-makoo tusoogwipunnedu.’
Soo numu-kooba katudu yise meeoo oo netamma, ‘Nu ka nenaduyana ooosapa numu-makoo tusoogwipunnedu, u sakwa uga ka ume e geana tooe how tooe sootunagase uga punno'o oo ma'ewa.’
Soo numu-kooba katudu yise ka mu numu oo konnodu mee netamma, ‘Ka oa tupe oo-makoo gwuuse ka nana sumumanoko (10) e makodyukudooadu saa'a gea.’
Mu numu yise meeoo netamma, ‘Mooasoo oosoo besa manepunne ewow oa tupe-ga'yoo. Ha'oo yise u oo-koobakwisoo oo tugeakwu?’
Pana soo numu-kooba katudu mu nanekwegea, ‘Soo numu ka pumme tu tugeana besa matuguna, oosoo ewasoo nageakwu. Soo numu yise ka gi toge tumatuguwunudu gi besa oo tzasooana umu-makoo nahanekwu.
Meno'o yise ka umu nuka wohonedu ka numu-kooba e katukwu-kwi gi e petzabedu yaatoo masumudoose yaa e poonnena'yoo kadoo mu mayugwe.’ ”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka meeoo unnemakwuse ka umu pumme nakatzimodu-no Jerusalem-kwitoo mea'a.
Bethpage noko Bethany mee nananeadu-kumi meana ka po'woadu Olive mee naneadu tzage'e petuga. O'no yise soo Te Pabe'e waahoo pumme nakatzimodu-matu taya, meeoo mu netammana,
“Ka Bethpage-witoo memeakwate. Onoko mu sumuoo tzagaze gisoo namadusoo'yookudu mayukwu, oo tsadopase nu-matoo oo wetzakake.
Ka numu mumme tubenga, ‘How mannena mu oo tzadoopa?’ mee mu nekwegea, ‘Ne Pabe'e oo soogwa'e.’ ”
Mu waha'yoo naana yise memease pumme tu tuukwe-kwa'nesoo oo mayu petuga.
Ka tzagaze mu tzadoopawunu, mu numu mu tubenga, “How manena mu a tzadoopa?”
Umu yise mu nekwegea, “Soo Ne Pabe'e a nekwa'e.” O'no mu numu yise gi hayoo mu netamma.
Mu waha'yoo naana yise ka tzagaze ka Te Pabe'e-baatoo tzakakase, wega oo-kooba hanese, soo Te Pabe'e ka mu wega-kooba katuno'o.
Ewa'yoo numu wega ka po-kooba wupatzeta.
Oosoo yise ka tuupetukana ka po'woadu Olive petakwana mea mu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu yise papaba apegeana oo nesookwuga'e ka oo manena poonnena.
Umu papaba apegeana, “U yow, Ne Tubetse Pabe'e ne magwetzoidu.”
Ewa'yoo mu Pharisee-matu yise meeow ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “Mu ume nakatzimodu nesagwiku.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mu nekwegea, “Ka umuoo gi unakwe, kukumma'yoosoo e nesookwugikwu.”
Ka Jerusalem mee naneadu tzage'e soo Te Pabe'e manegana ka Jerusalem poonnese mu numu tutuha soonammeguna mu yagakute
mee unakwe, “Tooe meno'o pana mu sakwa oo soopedakwadoo, ka mumme e soomagwetzoikwuse pana mu gi e nakaheesoobedya.
Saa'a umu mu wokwohomu mu na'oonakwi mani petuse mu takone petukwu, mu gi hownnekoo oo namatzatsebooe-wa'ne'yoo. Umu paa'a teepu tapo'wogese ka mu tupe koodeadoo-koobakwi mu-baa tsonooahookwu.

Umu mu numu kadoo'oo ma'ese mu nobe wunabetahookwu ka yow Jerusalem-witu. Gi sumu'yoo sapa natapo'wogedu tupe namayukwu. Sukwe puuwapudooahookwu. Soo Te Naa meno'osoo mu mabetseana mu magwetzoikwu mee tooe soonammepana mu gi ka Te Naa nakaheesoobedya.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka hemma-ma tumudu-matoo meahoo. Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu numu oe'yoona hemma-ma tumudu tayapebu'ahoo oosoo ka mu manena gi toge'yookuna. Ka mu tayana soo Te Pabe'e mee mu netamma, “Soo Te Naa ka umu o'nosoo tu yadooawabe ekow po tugupu,

content.text: ‘Soo e nobe pukwi'yoona no'obatusoo numu nanesootuhikwu.’

content: Mu ka e nobe-kwi'yoo gi besa manakwe ka mi'yoona nanatuduhana.”

Nonotsa tabeno soo Te Pabe'e mu numu tunedyooe ka nanesootuhipe-kwi'yoona. Mu Jew numu tutunehanewabe ka Te Pabe'e batsakwu mee unnena oo hoawi pana gi hownnekoo oo batsa-wa'ne'yoo ka mu numu ewa oo na'oonnakwi mamanepunne numu yise mu Jew numu tutunehanewabe tu'eapunnena o'no umu gi hownnekoo how Te Pabe'e yugwe.
